description: This file defines numeric types, conversion functions, and bit array classes used within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes templates for number handling, serialization, deserialization, and bit manipulation, as well as external function declarations for encoding and decoding digits and base64.
external_methods: EXTERNAL unsigned char FromDigits(const TCHAR element)
EXTERNAL unsigned char FromHexDigits(const TCHAR element)
EXTERNAL unsigned char FromBase64(const TCHAR element)
EXTERNAL unsigned char FromDirect(const TCHAR element)
EXTERNAL TCHAR ToDigits(const unsigned char element)
EXTERNAL TCHAR ToHexDigits(const unsigned char element)
EXTERNAL TCHAR ToBase64(const unsigned char element)
EXTERNAL TCHAR ToDirect(const unsigned char element)

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for handling numeric types with serialization, deserialization, and network conversion support.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts, supporting comparison and text representation.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base template class for fixed-size bit array manipulation.

classes.name: BitArrayType
classes.description: Derived class for fixed-size bit array with static size.

classes.name: BitArrayFlexType
classes.description: Derived class for flexible-size bit array.

methods.name: Composit
methods.description: Template method to compute floating point representation of Fractional.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of Fractional with specified decimal places.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Static template methods for converting string representations to numeric types.

methods.name: MaxSize
methods.description: Returns maximum size needed for string serialization of numbers.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns reference to the internal numeric value.

methods.name: operator TYPE
methods.description: Conversion operator to the underlying numeric type.
